conflicts.issue: The comment example prints128tests and85percent coverage without running tests. Placeholder output cannot become an execution receipt.
Step concurrency keywords and deployment:false are source platform claims that require product-version schema validation.
Some sample setup and checkout actions use mutable tags while source guidance asks for commit pinning. Strong local immutability requires reviewed full-SHA references.
Filtered workflows may leave required checks pending; selective work cannot weaken expected integration checks or exclude dependency effects.
Mock services are conditional test isolation tools. Their results cannot be substituted for real provider acceptance or authoritative runtime records.
Monorepo guidance concerns existing multipackage targets; preserve approved function-owned polyrepos.
Self-hosted runners, custom images, public registries, comments and deployment protections involve maintenance, spend or external mutations requiring applicable authority.
